resources.string: Dot-matrix clock and date for your home screen.
Long-press your home screen, open Widgets, then choose Dotwel Clock or Dotwel Date. Resize either widget from its handles. Style changes apply to every placed widget.
Typeface: DotGothic16 (SIL OFL 1.1). Design inspired by Nothing OS; this app is not affiliated with Nothing Technology Limited.
A dot-matrix digital clock with black, translucent or transparent styling.
A dot-matrix date widget with black, translucent or transparent styling.
